description: Get cached, partial rate observations for a hotel over a flexible date range. Use this for seasonality shape and to shortlist candidate check-in dates (e.g. "any week in May"), never to prove a missing date is unavailable. `nights` is the exact stay length and `end_date` is the latest checkout, not the latest check-in. Coverage is especially sparse far in the future. Confirm every selected exact stay with get_hotel_rates before stating availability or a bookable price.

end_date.description: Latest check-out date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

nights.description: Number of nights for each candidate stay.

start_date.description: Earliest check-in date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

name: get_multi_night_rates
